target_customer: Teams building and deploying AI agents that need to test them safely
problem: Agent behavior depends on the tools, data and state around it, and testing against live accounts is risky; Hue builds stateful clones of workplace apps and replays production runs as repeatable tests.
business_model: B2B developer tool (pricing not published, demo requests)
product_category: AI agent evaluation and simulation environments

founders.name: Aneesh Kethini
prior_employers: Datadog (second AI PM, built the AI SRE)

competitors.name: Arga Labs
competitors.what: Digital twins of SaaS tools for agent testing
competitors.funding_then: $10M seed led by General Catalyst, announced 2026-08

technical_complexity.rationale: Faithful stateful clones of apps like Gmail, Slack and Salesforce are hard; reviewers note fidelity versus live apps is unproven.

defensibility.rationale: Replay from real production traces could build data advantages, but at least one funded rival offers app clones and the team is two people.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too early to know; competitors raised $10M (Arga) and more in 2026.

market_need_then: Companies are deploying agents on real work in 2026 and coverage argues testing against live inboxes and customer databases is unsafe; no usage data for Hue yet.

branding.domain_note: Uses hue.run, with docs at docs.hue.run; no .com.

identity.visual_style: Calm, minimal, soft natural imagery such as sky and lily pads

brand_strength.rationale: Launched October 2026; only two trade articles and the site exist, and the word collides with Philips Hue and an unrelated video startup also named Hue.

outcome_analysis: Hue is a two person Fall 2026 YC company that launched on 2026-10-29 with simulated work apps for testing AI agents. There is no outcome yet and no disclosed funding. Its site claims backing from YC, Cursor, Clay and Vercel, and the crowded field already includes Arga Labs with a $10M seed, so execution and fidelity will decide the result.
notes: Site lists Cursor, Clay and Vercel as backers with no amounts; unverified as rounds. Search results for 'Hue seed' belong to other companies (Arga Labs, a video platform called Hue) and were excluded. Competitor entries as of the Fall 2026 batch.
